description: 2018~2020年離岸風力發電產業專業人才需求調查 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部產業發展署. 經濟部工業局即日起開放「2018-2020年離岸風力發電產業專業人才需求調查」資料集。 產業關鍵人才充足與否，為一產業發展之關鍵要素之一。 對國家總體而言，具有發展前景或影響國家經濟甚鉅之重點策略產業，不僅會投入大量的國家資源，且其成敗將影響未來數年的經濟成長。 因此投入離岸風力發電產業專業人才發展，將是產業成長的重要關鍵。 推動專業人才... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部產業發展署. Its tags are 求職及就業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2023-09-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
